notes.title: 04/30 Changelog
notes.content:
This update is still work in progress: there's some tweaks and polish we still want to do and description text is missing until the next update.

[list]
[*] Fixed the player sometimes spawning into the sea if they turn or teleport during a loading
[*] Repeater Handgun is not an automatic handgun, weaker damage but with an increasingly fast firing speed
[*] Akuma handgun now shoots explosions
[*] Hound assault rifle is now automatic with a tweak rate of fire
[*] Brute assault rifle now soots in 3 shot bursts
[*] Bird Of Prey sniper rifle needs to be reloaded every two shots now
[*] Wrath sniper rifle requires no reloading, pushes back player, pushes back enemies
[*] Gun ma shotgun no pushed back enemies
[*] Crusher shotgun now shoots grenades
[*] Fixed the vending machine in the tutorial selling all weapons
[*] Reduced the amount of Biomass in Island 1 and 2
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35796363/d4423cf58a7444b2fdcf848667dcccf48d7c76ef.png[/img]

notes.title: 04/27 Changelog
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added an extra base on Sector Alpha (first island)
[*] Improved visibility off sniper crosshair
[*] Improved readability of player position on the UI map
[*] Improved some rocks collisions that were too big
[*] Fixed a potential crash when shooting Xenos with the Ifrit bow
[*] Fixed knives sticking in the air if the player touches a wall
[*] Vending terminal will now spawn ammo packs x5
[*] Changes to how vertical teleport movement is handled (still WIP)
[*] Fixed gripping errors when triggering a loading screen while holding guns
[*] Fixed the radar being offset after holstering a gun on the left
[*] Added headshot hitbox to the Alpha
[*] Fixed a lever being too high
[*] Fixed the fire being detached from the spaceship in the credits scene
[*] Tweaked level design to allow for better movement of the Alpha
[*] Add a new game button to start a game from scratch
[*] Fixed the Xenos sometimes looking at items other than the player, thus creating errors
[*] Fixed an error when the Alpha would try to reach an unreachable object and divert attention from the player
[/list]

notes.title: 04/24 Changelog
notes.content:
* Hotfix AI Bug --- Xenos losing they will to fight
* Fixed game ending not triggering properly
* Fixed bugs that would make the knife ineffective against dinosaurs
* Fixed the enemies' position on the radar sometimes appearing far away
* Spawn less resources when shooting plants/metal boxes. Use a knife for full yield
* Increased main weapon holster hit box size (on the player's back)

notes.title: 23/04 Change Log
notes.content:
[h1]This is the first of a regular streak of updates! [/h1]

[b]What's in update 23/04[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that made the raptor no see you correctly
[*]Teleportation movement new position is now be based on the player original position and not the play area center pivot point
[*]Snapping rotation rotates around the player position and not the play area center pivot
[*]Attempted to fix the crash when shooting explosive arrows
[*]Explosive plants now correctly detonate when shot with the Ifrit bow
[*]Fixed many graphic bugs in Island 1
[*]Fixed the Alpha not disappearing from the radar after dying
[/list]
